card.name: Scattered words in clinical sentences
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on varied words such as 'of' after an author name, 'kill', 'ers' in beta-blockers, and 'with' before duration.
card.plain: It responds to a mixed set of unrelated words in drug and medical text, with no pattern a reader could rely on.
